message: x-fern-pagination must be an object, or a boolean to inherit the document-level x-fern-pagination.

x-fern-pagination is not a valid pagination configuration. Declare cursor pagination (cursor, next_cursor, results), offset pagination (offset, results, and optionally step and has-next-page), uri pagination (next_uri, results), path pagination (next_path, results) or custom pagination (type: custom, results).
x-fern-pagination declares cursor pagination, which requires 'next_cursor'.
x-fern-pagination 'offset' must be a string selector such as '$request.offset'.
x-fern-pagination 'results' must be a string selector such as '$response.results'.
x-fern-pagination declares custom pagination, which requires 'results'.
